title: Airway Basics, BVM, and the PCP's CPAP and PEEP

slides.title: Today's lesson
slides.body:
As an EMR you already open airways, clear choking, suction, insert OPAs and NPAs, and ventilate with a BVM. Today, as a PCP:

  1. Refresh the basics with the exact BC numbers
  2. Ventilate well: rate, seal, chest rise
  3. Use CPAP and the PEEP valve, PCP-only tools in BC

Textbook: Chapter 13, PDF pages 967–1060
slides.say: Welcome to the hands-on part of this chapter. As EMRs, you already open airways, clear choking, suction, insert oral and nasal airways, give oxygen, and ventilate with a BVM. We'll refresh those quickly with the exact numbers the BC protocols use. Then we'll spend most of our time on what's new: running a BVM really well, and the two pressure tools that only PCPs use in BC, CPAP and the PEEP valve. You'll learn who gets CPAP, who must not, and how to set it up.
slides.sayZh: 欢迎来到本章的动手部分。作为 EMR，你们已经会开放气道、处理窒息、吸引、放口咽和鼻咽通气道、给氧，以及用 BVM 通气。这些我们会用 BC 流程里的准确数字快速复习一遍。然后把大部分时间放在新内容上：怎样把 BVM 做到真正好，以及在 BC 只有 PCP 才能用的两样压力工具：CPAP 和 PEEP 阀。你会学到谁可以用 CPAP、谁绝对不能用，以及怎么设置。

slides.title: Quick refresher, BC-style
slides.body:
SkillKey rule
Head tilt–chin liftNo trauma
Jaw thrustSuspected spine injury
OPANo gag reflex; earlobe to mouth corner
NPAGag OK; nose tip to earlobe; not if skull fracture
Suction (BC)Adult 10–15 s, child 10 s, infant 5 s
slides.say: Here's a quick refresher. Without trauma, use the head-tilt chin-lift; with a suspected spine injury, use the jaw thrust, with no head tilt. An oral airway is only for patients with no gag reflex; measure from the earlobe to the corner of the mouth. A nasal airway is tolerated when the gag reflex is still there; measure from the tip of the nose to the earlobe, and don't use it with a suspected skull fracture or nasal injury. Neither adjunct prevents aspiration. For suction, BC limits each attempt to ten to fifteen seconds in an adult, ten in a child, and five in an infant. Pre-oxygenate first, and suction only while withdrawing.
slides.sayZh: 快速复习一下。没有外伤用仰头抬颏法；怀疑脊柱损伤用推举下颌法，不要仰头。口咽通气道只给没有呕吐反射的病人，从耳垂量到口角。鼻咽通气道在呕吐反射还在时也能耐受，从鼻尖量到耳垂；怀疑颅骨骨折或鼻部外伤时不要用。两种辅助装置都不能防误吸。吸引方面，BC 规定每次成人十到十五秒、儿童十秒、婴儿五秒。先预给氧，只在往外退时吸。

slides.title: Choking: the BC protocol
slides.body:
• Partial: have them cough forcefully; watch closely
  • Complete, conscious, over 1 yr: thrusts or back slaps, sets of 5
  • Infant: 5 back blows, then 5 chest compressions
  • Collapses: CPR, no pulse check; look in the mouth before breaths
  • No blind finger sweeps; remove only what you see
slides.say: Choking, or foreign body airway obstruction, has its own BC protocol, so follow it exactly. If the obstruction is partial and the patient can cough, have them cough forcefully and watch closely. If it's complete in a conscious adult or a child over one year, BC accepts abdominal thrusts, chest thrusts or back slaps, and you may alternate two techniques in sets of five. For an infant, give five back blows, then five chest compressions, and repeat. If the patient collapses, start CPR with compressions, without a pulse check. After thirty compressions, open the airway and look. Remove the object only if you see it; no blind finger sweeps. Then try two breaths and continue.
slides.sayZh: 窒息，也就是异物气道梗阻，BC 有专门的流程，要严格照做。如果是部分梗阻、病人还能咳，就让他用力咳并密切观察。如果是清醒的成人或一岁以上儿童完全梗阻，BC 接受腹部冲击、胸部冲击或背部拍击，也可以两种方法每组五次交替。婴儿给五次背部拍击、再五次胸外按压，反复进行。如果病人倒下，直接从按压开始做 CPR，不查脉搏。按压三十次后打开气道看一看，看见异物才取出，不要盲目用手指掏，然后尝试吹两口气，继续循环。

slides.q: An unconscious adult lies on a restaurant floor; nobody saw him collapse. He isn't breathing. Your breath won't go in, even after repositioning. Next?
options: Do a blind finger sweep to find the object
Start compressions; look in the mouth before each set of breaths
Give five abdominal thrusts while he is lying down
Check the pulse for one full minute
slides.say: Let's pause for a question. An unconscious adult man lies on a restaurant floor, and nobody saw him collapse. He isn't breathing. Your first breath won't go in, and it still won't after you reposition the head. What next? A, do a blind finger sweep to find the object. B, start compressions, and look in the mouth before each set of breaths. C, give five abdominal thrusts while he's lying down. D, check the pulse for one full minute. Tap your answer.
slides.sayZh: 停一下考考你。一名无意识的成年男子躺在餐厅地上，没人看到他倒下。他没有呼吸。你吹第一口气进不去，重新摆好头位后还是进不去。下一步怎么做？A，盲目用手指掏异物；B，开始按压，每组吹气前先看口腔；C，在他躺着时做五次腹部冲击；D，摸脉搏整整一分钟。点选你的答案。
slides.explain: The answer is B. In BC's unwitnessed, unconscious protocol, if the breath still won't go in after repositioning, start compressions, thirty to two, and look in the mouth before each set of breaths, removing any object you can see. A is wrong because blind sweeps can push the object deeper. C is not part of the BC unconscious sequence. D wastes critical time; BC checks breathing and pulse for no more than ten seconds.
slides.explainZh: 答案是 B。按 BC 无目击、无意识的流程，重新摆头位后气还是吹不进，就开始按压，三十比二，每组吹气前先看口腔，看得见的异物就取出。A 错，盲目指掏可能把异物推得更深。C 不在 BC 的无意识处理步骤里。D 浪费宝贵时间；BC 检查呼吸和脉搏不超过十秒。

slides.title: Oxygen devices and BC rules
slides.body:
DeviceFlowO₂ delivered
Nasal cannula1–6 L/min24–44%
Non-rebreather15 L/minup to 90%
Pocket mask + O₂15 L/minabout 55%
BVM + reservoir15 L/minnearly 100%
  • Never an adult mask below 6 L/min
  • NRB for CO poisoning and smoke inhalation
slides.say: Here are the oxygen numbers to know. A nasal cannula at one to six litres a minute gives about twenty-four to forty-four percent. A non-rebreather at fifteen litres gives up to ninety percent, but only if the patient breathes deeply enough to draw from the bag, so fill the bag first. A pocket mask with oxygen at fifteen litres gives about fifty-five percent, and a BVM with a reservoir at fifteen litres gives nearly one hundred percent. Two BC rules: never run an adult mask below six litres a minute, or the patient gets less oxygen than room air. And use a non-rebreather for carbon monoxide poisoning and smoke inhalation.
slides.sayZh: 这些给氧数字要记住。鼻导管每分钟一到六升，给大约百分之二十四到四十四。非重复呼吸面罩每分钟十五升，最多给到百分之九十，但前提是病人吸得够深、能从储氧袋里吸气，所以要先把袋子充满。口袋面罩接氧每分钟十五升，大约百分之五十五；带储氧袋的 BVM 每分钟十五升，接近百分之百。BC 有两条规定：成人面罩流量绝不能低于每分钟六升，否则病人吸到的氧比室内空气还少；一氧化碳中毒和吸入烟雾用非重复呼吸面罩。

slides.title: BVM: doing it really well
slides.body:
• Apneic with pulse: adult 10–12/min; child, infant 12–20/min
  • Each breath over 1 second, just to chest rise
  • Two-person BVM beats one-person: better seal and volume
  • Working: equal rise, breath sounds, HR and SpO₂ improve
  • Obese: ramp until ear canal is level with sternal notch
slides.say: Let's make your BVM excellent. For an adult who is apneic with a pulse, give ten to twelve breaths a minute; for infants and children, twelve to twenty. Squeeze each breath over one second, just enough to see the chest rise. Over-ventilating raises chest pressure, lowers cardiac output, and pushes air into the stomach. When you can, use two people: one holds the seal and the airway, the other squeezes. Ventilation is working if the chest rises equally, you hear breath sounds, and the heart rate and saturation improve. For an obese patient, ramp the head and shoulders up until the ear canal is level with the top of the sternum.
slides.sayZh: 我们来把 BVM 做到出色。有脉搏、无呼吸的成人每分钟十到十二次；婴儿和儿童十二到二十次。每口气用一秒挤完，刚好看到胸廓起伏就够。过度通气会升高胸腔压力、降低心输出量，还会把气打进胃里。条件允许就用双人法：一人负责密封和开放气道，一人挤球。通气有效的表现是：两侧胸廓起伏均等、听得到呼吸音、心率和血氧改善。肥胖病人要把头肩垫高成斜坡位，直到外耳道和胸骨上切迹齐平。

slides.title: CPAP: how it helps
slides.body:
Steady pressure in the airways→alveoli stay open→more O₂ in, less work
  • Pushes fluid out of the alveoli in pulmonary edema
  • BC: reduces intubation and mortality
  • Needs an awake patient who is breathing
  • Treats the symptom, not the cause
slides.say: CPAP, continuous positive airway pressure, is the first PCP-only tool today. The patient breathes on their own through a tight mask, while the device keeps a steady pressure in the airways, even at the end of each breath out. That pressure holds the small air sacs open, so more lung surface takes part in gas exchange and more oxygen crosses into the blood. In pulmonary edema, it also pushes fluid back out of the alveoli. Breathing takes less work and uses less oxygen. BC notes that CPAP reduces the need for intubation and lowers mortality. Remember, CPAP needs an awake patient who is breathing on their own, and it treats the symptom, not the cause.
slides.sayZh: CPAP，持续气道正压，是今天第一样只有 PCP 能用的工具。病人通过一个贴紧的面罩自己呼吸，设备在气道里维持一个稳定的压力，连呼气末也不消失。这个压力把小肺泡撑开，让更多肺表面参与气体交换，更多氧气进入血液。肺水肿时，它还会把液体推出肺泡。呼吸更省力，消耗的氧也更少。BC 指出 CPAP 能减少插管需要、降低死亡率。记住：CPAP 需要清醒、能自己呼吸的病人；它治的是症状，不是病因。

slides.title: CPAP in BC: who gets it
slides.body:
Use: all of theseDon't use
Age ≥ 13, significant distressAge 12 or under
Awake, follows commandsLow LOC, arrest, hypoventilation
Keeps own airway openVomiting or aspiration risk; poor mask fit
RR > 24, SpO₂ < 94% on O₂, accessory musclesTrauma cause, pneumothorax, tracheostomy
e.g. CHF, asthma, COPD, pneumonia, submersionSystolic BP < 90
slides.say: In BC, CPAP is for patients thirteen or older in significant respiratory distress who are awake, follow commands, and keep their own airway open. They must have all three signs: a rate above twenty-four, a saturation under ninety-four percent on oxygen, and accessory muscle use. Typical causes are heart failure with pulmonary edema, asthma, COPD, pneumonia and submersion. The contraindications: age twelve or under; decreased consciousness or not following commands; respiratory arrest or hypoventilation; vomiting or any aspiration risk; a mask that won't fit; a traumatic cause; a tracheostomy; a known or suspected pneumothorax; and a systolic pressure under ninety. A tiring patient, with slow, shallow breaths and falling consciousness, needs a BVM, not CPAP.
slides.sayZh: 在 BC，CPAP 用于十三岁及以上、有明显呼吸窘迫、清醒、能听从指令、能自己保持气道通畅的病人。必须同时具备三个体征：呼吸频率超过二十四、吸氧状态下血氧低于百分之九十四、使用辅助呼吸肌。典型病因有心衰伴肺水肿、哮喘、COPD、肺炎和淹溺。禁忌证：十二岁及以下；意识下降或不能听从指令；呼吸停止或通气不足；呕吐或任何误吸风险；面罩戴不合；外伤引起；气管造口；已知或怀疑气胸；收缩压低于九十。一个正在耗竭、呼吸慢而浅、意识下降的病人需要的是 BVM，不是 CPAP。

slides.title: Applying CPAP, step by step
slides.body:
1. Check indications, contraindications, blood pressure; explain
  2. Start: O₂ 5 L/min, CPAP valve 5 cmH₂O
  3. Get a facial seal; let the patient hold the mask first
  4. Reassess the patient and vital signs
  5. Go up in 2.5 cmH₂O steps to a maximum of 10

Worse? Remove CPAP, ventilate with a BVM, consider PEEP. Some units empty a D cylinder in 5–10 min.
slides.say: Here's how to apply CPAP the BC way. Check indications, contraindications and blood pressure, and explain what you're doing. Sit the patient fully upright. Start with oxygen at five litres per minute and the CPAP valve at five centimetres of water. Get a good facial seal; frightened patients often do better holding the mask themselves at first while you coach them. Reassess the patient and the vital signs. If needed, increase in steps of two point five, up to a maximum of ten centimetres of water. If the patient deteriorates, remove CPAP and ventilate with a BVM, considering a PEEP valve. And watch your oxygen: some CPAP units can empty a D cylinder in five to ten minutes.
slides.sayZh: 按 BC 的方式上 CPAP：确认适应证和禁忌证，测血压，向病人解释你要做什么。让病人完全坐直。起始氧流量每分钟五升，CPAP 阀五厘米水柱。做好面部密封；害怕的病人常常先自己扶着面罩、你在旁边指导，效果更好。复评病人和生命体征。需要时每次加二点五，最高到十厘米水柱。如果病人恶化，撤掉 CPAP，用 BVM 通气，并考虑加 PEEP 阀。还要盯着氧气：有些 CPAP 设备五到十分钟就能用完一个 D 瓶。

slides.q: A 68-year-old with heart failure sits bolt upright, alert. RR 32, neck muscles working, SpO₂ 89% on a non-rebreather, BP 156/92. What should the PCP do?
options: Keep the non-rebreather; CPAP is only for SpO₂ below 85%
CPAP at 5 cmH₂O with O₂ at 5 L/min, reassess, step up by 2.5 if needed
Start CPAP at 15 cmH₂O for a faster response
Ventilate with a BVM and a PEEP valve at 10 cmH₂O right away
slides.say: Let's try a PCP decision. A sixty-eight-year-old with heart failure sits bolt upright and alert. Rate thirty-two, neck muscles working, saturation eighty-nine percent on a non-rebreather, blood pressure one fifty-six over ninety-two. What should the PCP do? A, keep the non-rebreather; CPAP is only for a saturation below eighty-five. B, CPAP at five with oxygen at five litres per minute, reassess, and step up by two point five if needed. C, start CPAP at fifteen for a faster response. D, a BVM with a PEEP valve at ten right away. Tap your answer.
slides.sayZh: 来一道 PCP 决策题。一名六十八岁心衰病人端坐、清醒，呼吸每分钟三十二次，颈部肌肉在用力，戴非重复呼吸面罩血氧百分之八十九，血压一百五十六比九十二。PCP 应该怎么做？A，继续用非重复呼吸面罩，CPAP 只用于血氧低于八十五；B，CPAP 从五开始、氧流量每分钟五升，复评，需要时每次加二点五；C，CPAP 直接开到十五，见效更快；D，马上用 BVM 加十的 PEEP 阀。点选你的答案。
slides.explain: The answer is B. He meets every BC criterion: older than thirteen, alert, airway open, a rate above twenty-four, a saturation under ninety-four on oxygen, accessory muscle use, and a systolic well above ninety. BC starts at five centimetres of water and five litres per minute, then steps up by two point five to a maximum of ten. A uses a threshold BC doesn't use. C exceeds the maximum of ten. D is for patients who can't breathe adequately on their own.
slides.explainZh: 答案是 B。他符合 BC 的每一条标准：超过十三岁、清醒、气道通畅、呼吸频率超过二十四、吸氧下血氧低于九十四、使用辅助呼吸肌，收缩压也远高于九十。BC 从五厘米水柱、每分钟五升开始，再每次加二点五，最高到十。A 用的阈值 BC 并不用；C 超过上限十；D 是给不能自己充分呼吸的病人用的。

slides.title: The PEEP valve on your BVM
slides.body:
1. Attach the PEEP valve to the BVM exhaust port
  2. Set it to 5 cmH₂O
  3. Good seal; ventilate usually no more than 8–10/min
  4. Monitor SpO₂ and blood pressure
  5. May go up by 2.5 cmH₂O to a maximum of 10

Systolic < 90 or cardiac arrest: remove the PEEP valve.
slides.say: The second PCP-only tool is the PEEP valve, for positive end-expiratory pressure. It fits on the exhaust port of your BVM and keeps some pressure in the lungs after each breath, so the alveoli don't collapse between your ventilations. It's for the patient you're bagging, who isn't safe for CPAP. Set it at five centimetres of water, keep a good seal, and ventilate at an appropriate rate, usually no more than eight to ten breaths a minute. Watch the saturation and the blood pressure. You may go up in steps of two point five, to a maximum of ten. If the systolic drops below ninety, or the patient arrests, take the PEEP valve off.
slides.sayZh: 第二样 PCP 专属工具是 PEEP 阀，PEEP 指呼气末正压。它装在 BVM 的排气口上，每次通气后在肺里留住一点压力，让肺泡在两次通气之间不塌陷。它用于你正在捏球、不适合 CPAP 的病人。设在五厘米水柱，保持良好密封，用合适的频率通气，通常每分钟不超过八到十次。盯着血氧和血压。可以每次加二点五，最高到十。如果收缩压降到九十以下，或者病人心脏骤停，就把 PEEP 阀取下。

slides.title: EMR vs PCP: the BC oxygen ladder
slides.body:
BC oxygen administration: short of breath, in shock or CO-poisoned needs high-flow O₂

All licence levels (EMR + PCP)

  • Titrate O₂ up to 15 L/min for SpO₂ 94%
  • NRB at 15 L/min, then add a nasal cannula at 15 L/min under it
  • Assisted ventilations with a BVM
  • Record SpO₂ changes

PCP adds

  • Consider CPAP
  • Assisted ventilations with PEEP
slides.say: Here's the BC oxygen ladder. For patients who are short of breath, in shock, or poisoned with carbon monoxide, every licence level climbs the same first steps: titrate oxygen up to fifteen litres a minute aiming for ninety-four percent, switch to a non-rebreather at fifteen, then add a nasal cannula at fifteen litres under the non-rebreather. If that's still not enough, anyone can assist ventilations with a BVM, and everyone records how the saturation changes. The right column is new. The PCP can consider CPAP for the patient who is still breathing well enough on their own, and can add a PEEP valve when bagging.
slides.sayZh: 这是 BC 的给氧阶梯。对气促、休克或一氧化碳中毒的病人，各级别爬的前几级都一样：把氧流量调到最高每分钟十五升，目标血氧百分之九十四；改用非重复呼吸面罩，每分钟十五升；再在面罩下面加一个鼻导管，也是每分钟十五升。还不够的话，各级别都可以用 BVM 辅助通气，并且都要记录血氧的变化。右栏是新的：对自主呼吸仍足够的病人，PCP 可以考虑 CPAP；捏球时可以加 PEEP 阀。

slides.title: New for you as a PCP: watch out for
slides.body:
• CPAP and PEEP can drop the BP: less blood back to the heart
  • Pressure can cause a pneumothorax: keep listening
  • Air in the stomach: vomiting, aspiration; have suction ready
  • Panicking patient: coach, never force the mask
  • Not on the PCP exam: intubation, RSI drugs, surgical airways
slides.say: Here's what's new to watch out for. CPAP and PEEP both raise the pressure inside the chest. That slows blood returning to the heart and can drop the blood pressure, so check it often. A systolic under ninety rules out CPAP, and it's the signal to take the PEEP valve off. High pressure can also cause a pneumothorax, so keep listening to the lungs. Air can enter the stomach and lead to vomiting and aspiration, so have suction ready. A frightened, hypoxic patient may feel smothered by the mask; coach them, and never force it. Finally, know what the exam leaves out. Intubation, the sedation and paralytic drugs of rapid-sequence intubation, and surgical airways aren't on the BC PCP licensing exam.
slides.sayZh: 这些是新的注意事项。CPAP 和 PEEP 都会升高胸腔内压力，减慢血液回流心脏，可能让血压下降，所以要经常测血压。收缩压低于九十是 CPAP 的禁忌证，也是取下 PEEP 阀的信号。高压力还可能造成气胸，所以要持续听肺。空气可能进入胃里，引起呕吐和误吸，所以吸引器要备好。一个害怕又缺氧的病人可能觉得面罩让他窒息，要引导他，绝不要强行扣上。最后要清楚考试不考什么：气管插管、快速顺序插管用的镇静药和肌松药，以及外科气道，都不在 BC PCP 执照考试范围内。

slides.title: For the BC exam
slides.body:
• Book: CPAP if SpO₂ < 90%
  • BC: age ≥ 13 + RR > 24 + SpO₂ < 94% on O₂ + accessory muscles
  • With PEEP: usually no more than 8–10 breaths/min
  • Suction: BC adult 10–15 s (book: 15 s)
  • Choking collapse: BC 30:2 for adults, even with 2 rescuers

The book adds a laryngoscope and Magill forceps for choking; the BC protocol does not list them.
slides.say: Book versus BC. The textbook suggests CPAP when the saturation is under ninety percent; BC uses age thirteen or older, plus a rate above twenty-four, a saturation under ninety-four on oxygen, and accessory muscle use. With a PEEP valve, BC usually ventilates at no more than eight to ten breaths a minute. BC suction is ten to fifteen seconds in an adult; the book says fifteen. For a choking adult who collapses, BC uses thirty compressions to two breaths, even with two rescuers, and no pulse check. The book also describes a laryngoscope and Magill forceps for choking, but the BC protocol doesn't list them.
slides.sayZh: 教材和 BC 对照。教材建议血氧低于百分之九十时用 CPAP；BC 要求十三岁及以上，加上呼吸频率超过二十四、吸氧下血氧低于九十四、使用辅助呼吸肌。用 PEEP 阀时，BC 的通气频率通常每分钟不超过八到十次。BC 成人吸引是十到十五秒，书上写十五秒。成人窒息倒下后，BC 按三十比二，即使有两名施救者，而且不查脉搏。书里还讲了用喉镜和 Magill 钳取异物，但 BC 流程没有列出这些。

slides.title: Three things to remember
slides.body:
1. Basics the BC way: suction 10–15 / 10 / 5 s; no blind sweeps
  2. BVM: adult 10–12/min, 1 second, chest rise; two people if you can
  3. PCP adds CPAP (awake, breathing) and PEEP (bagging); both can drop BP

Next: gastric distention and advanced airways
slides.say: Three things to remember. One: do the basics the BC way. Suction ten to fifteen seconds in an adult, ten in a child, five in an infant, and no blind finger sweeps. Two: ventilate well. Ten to twelve breaths a minute for an adult, each over one second, with two people whenever you can. Three: as a PCP, you add CPAP for the awake patient who is still breathing, and the PEEP valve for the patient you're bagging. Both start at five, go up by two point five to a maximum of ten, and both can drop the blood pressure. Next lesson: gastric distention and advanced airways. If anything was unclear, tap Ask. See you next class.
slides.sayZh: 收尾三句话。一，按 BC 的方式做好基础：吸引成人十到十五秒、儿童十秒、婴儿五秒，不要盲目指掏。二，通气要做好：成人每分钟十到十二次，每口一秒，人手够就用双人法。三，作为 PCP，你多了 CPAP，给清醒、能自己呼吸的病人；还有 PEEP 阀，给你在捏球的病人。两者都从五开始、每次加二点五、最高十，而且都可能让血压下降。下节课讲胃胀气和高级气道。有不懂的点「Ask」。下节课见。
